ocr_engine: Advanced Client-Side Multi-Variant Preprocessing & OCR Engine (PaddleOCR/CRNN adapter with Tesseract fallback)
tracker: ByteTrack (Kalman Filter + Hungarian Algorithm Multi-Object Association)

findings.detection_weakness: Plate localization bounding boxes occasionally drift into bumper, windshield, or vehicle body without boundary clamping and geometric aspect-ratio filtering.
findings.ocr_weakness: Direct raw OCR on noisy frames suffers from character transposition (O/0, I/1, B/8, S/5, Z/2) when lacking structured positional syntax validation.
findings.registration_gap: Previous system marked any regex match as 'verified'. System must enforce strict separation between syntactic format validation and authoritative registration verification.
findings.temporal_consensus: Single-frame OCR produces inconsistent readings across frames; temporal consensus voting across persistent ByteTrack IDs dramatically stabilizes read accuracy without model retraining.
